notes.title: Update 0.27
notes.notes: [p]Hi :3[/p][p]Just a medium update after more than 2 months without any news, this patch adds a lot of bug fixes and changes the UI in-game to make it feel more interactive![/p][h1]Changelog[/h1][p]Added [b]post-processing to almost all UI[/b] and menus[/p][p]The music now muffles when the fear meter rises, and the same with a grain effect[/p][p]Added an [b]exclusive player icon[/b] in the top left of the screen if the player has a S-rank[/p][p][b]Changed the build type to Mono so mods can be made with ease[/b][/p][p]Changed \[Throw knife] card's chances to 1/3[/p][p]Changed the gun model in the \[Gun]'s animation to look better[/p][p]Changed the \[Gun]'s animation[/p][p]Changed command line sounds[/p][p]Changed the snake achievement so it can also be obtained with the pong minigame[/p][p]Changed Duviz's icon in credits[/p][p]Fixed a bug preventing the players from creating presets[/p][p]Fixed steam thinking that the player is still in a game while they are in the menu[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.26
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hi chat[/b]

Here you have an update for Tres, adding a gamemodes system.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121790/250dbd65449501d69e68b4ff8319bb37bf72c89f.png"][/img]
[b]Changelog 0.26:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p] Added [b]presets[/b]
[list][*][p] Presets are a way to create your own gamemode to customize how you play the game. For now, you can toggle the text chat, the timer (aka quick mode), extra cards added per round and cards players start with
[/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p] Added a sequence before starting the game
[/p][/*][*][p] Changed the store page
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a bug that caused the player unable to create a lobby after entering a tape
[/p][/*][/list][p] I forgot to say that I added a new event in the last update... Well... Surprise I guess.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.25
notes.notes:
Hi!!!!!1!

After a long time, here's an update that adds a lot of little stuff to make the game better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121790/bf66c2288970cfc4bfe48dece80a38035d4d2031.png[/img]

[b]Changelog 0.25:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [b]a clock[/b] in-game to reflect the time and interact with quick mode
[*] Added [b]A LOT[/b] of [u]new music[/u] (Thanks Wolicraft)
[*] Added two [b]new cosmetics[/b]
[*] Added an [b]info tab[/b] in the top left in-game
[*] Added the ability to [b]wear multiple cosmetics[/b] at the same time
[*] Added the ability to draw by clicking the cards's holder
[*] Added the ability to zoom with the camera in-game
[*] Added a popup for the browse menu
[*] Added pop ups when you change ranks
[*] Added [spoiler]tapes[/spoiler] on the menu to replay [spoiler]secret scenes[/spoiler]
[*] Added descriptions to the buttons on the menu
[*] Added extra options in the extras menu (press the Konami code in-game)
[*] Changed the camera position in-game
[*] Changed once more the animation of buttons
[*] Changed fonts in some parts in the main menu
[*] Changed some texts
[*] Changed the positions of some decorations in-game
[*] Changed the draw animation
[*] Changed the default pronouns to now be They/Them (Sorry I forgot to change it since I added them)
[*] Compressed a lot of textures
[*] Extended the idle animation
[*] Reworked the corruption effect
[*] Fixed a lot of errors with the turns in-game
[*] A lot more that I don't remember...
[/list]
